description: Read the workspace, one task, one agent communication inbox/outbox, or one durable prompt/reply thread by supplying at most one selector. query searches past messages, findings, decisions and handoffs; search before asking a peer what was already found.

agent_id.description: Your own agent id to read your inbox/outbox with receipts (another agent shows presence only). With message_id or task_id, names you as the reader where Concord cannot see your session.

include_superseded.description: Include superseded decisions in task context (hidden by default)

query.description: Search past messages you sent or received, and task findings, decisions and handoffs, for this text. Results name the task_id or message_id to open next.

task_id.description: Task to inspect; omit for the whole workspace state

workspace_id.description: Workspace id returned by a Concord operation. Omit to use the automatically resolved repository workspace.

name: inspect_work
title: Inspect work
